verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a TOTP/HOTP code-generator app, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of tool. The evidence covers only code syncing, QR transfer, editing, Privacy Screen and the open-source OTP and PAM implementations, with no mention of an MCP server or any agent connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
